mapping.sheet: Foot default1.6mm, adjustable1.6–2; deck backing redesigned2–2.6mm.
mapping.interfaces: Two foot tongues4.5mm wide, sheet thick, backing-thickness deep. Deck sockets(sheet+fit)x(4.5+fit). Feet shoulder height16mm.
mapping.allowance: Proposed .15mm TOTAL default,.1–.3mm, not the measured .100012 gap; calibrate and bond two fixed seats.
mapping.tabs: 16 Boolean-unioned bed-flat runners,.8–1.4wide,.4–.6thick, increased from source .21/.22 planes; snip1.6mm outside edges, away from functional tongues.

originalDesign.interaction: Hand-held straight-edged scraper sweeps trapezoid ribs on a fixed raised deck; separate hand steadies two socketed feet. Not a captive mechanism; no tuned sound claim.
originalDesign.assembly: Lower deck onto two upward foot tongues; open Z insertion path, no trapped or elastically sprung part. Bond calibrated seats; free scraper is held by hand.
originalDesign.artKeepout: 13mm diameter protected patch at W/2+7,L/2, remote from sockets/ridges; .4–.6mm engraving leaves>=1.4mm continuous backing.
